product_name: NOAA/NSSL MRMS SeamlessHSR hybrid-scan reflectivity composite + PrecipFlag/PrecipRate (CONUS, Alaska, Hawaii, Caribbean; dBZ, public domain) + ECCC North American Radar Composite 1km rain (RADAR_1KM_RRAI, mm/h) / snow (RADAR_1KM_RSNO, cm/h) / precipitation type (Radar_1km_SfcPrecipType) + EUMETNET OPERA EU DBZH composite (CC BY 4.0) in remaining radar gaps + JMA Japan nowcast (attribution) in Japan gaps + NOAA GFS model estimates, same colors (public domain) in verified radar gaps only
variable: MRMS SeamlessHSR base reflectivity dBZ (CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB) with PrecipFlag snow detection; ECCC precipitation-rate rain (mm/h)/snow (cm/h) mapped to dBZ through the ECCC 14-color class rates with the NWS Z=300R^1.4 equivalence (equal ECCC colors = equal severity = equal dBZ for rain and snow); ECCC SfcPrecipType gates snow-blue rendering. One 5-75 dBZ key for rain + 8-step blue snow ramp at matched severity (MRMS snow from PrecipFlag 3 + PrecipRate at 10:1 SLR).
units: dBZ key: MRMS/OPERA measured; ECCC Z-R estimated equivalents; MRMS snow = PrecipFlag snow -> snow ramp (PrecipRate at 10:1 SLR)
spatial_resolution_source: MRMS SeamlessHSR ~1km CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB composite 2-min (measured dBZ -> N0Q key; PrecipFlag snow -> snow ramp); ECCC 1km rain/snow/type 6-min (rain rates -> estimated dBZ via NWS Z=300R^1.4; snow classes cm/h -> snow rows directly)
spatial_resolution_rendered: 1800x1175 canvas over lon [-93.0,-73.5], lat [40.5,49.5] (mean-value binning, no upsampling of source precision)
missing_data_treatment: ECCC type-gated (SfcPrecipType snow -> blue ramp; other types -> dBZ key) where RADAR_COVERAGE_*.INV is transparent; MRMS SeamlessHSR (CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB) fills ECCC gaps (measured dBZ -> N0Q key bins; PrecipFlag snow -> blue snow ramp); 10-px cross-fade on the coverage edge; OPERA EU + JMA JP radar fill remaining gaps; GFS model estimates only in verified radar gaps; transparent elsewhere; never zero-filled.
shoreline_mask: assets/great_lakes_watermask.png — shared NOAA medium-resolution shoreline water mask (nautical-chart compilation, mean-high-water datum; snapped + polygonized once, full vertex precision, antialiased). Overlay alpha is multiplied by this mask and edge RGB is bled into transparent pixels (anti-fringe for bilinear clients), so every product shares one shoreline.

legend_scale_html: Precipitation intensity (measured radar reflectivity, dBZ, OBSERVED radar echo): LOWEST 5 Very Light cyan/blue (drizzle, mist) → Light greens (~20-30: light rain/snow) → Moderate dark green (~30-40: steady rain/snow) → Heavy yellow/orange (~40-50: heavy rain) → Severe red (~50-60: severe storms, hail possible) → Intense magenta/purple (~60-70: violent storms, large hail) → HIGHEST+ 70+ Extreme white (destructive hail, debris). Same dBZ always shows the same color in every season — rain, snow, lake-effect snow, thunderstorms. No echo (no precipitation) stays see-through so the map underneath shows. Measurement types differ by source: MRMS SeamlessHSR (CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB) and OPERA are MEASURED reflectivity (dBZ); ECCC rain colors are ESTIMATED dBZ equivalents converted from rain rates via Z=300R^1.4 (ECCC publishes mm/h, not dBZ — high-rate classes saturate near ~57 dBZ, so ECCC never paints the white extreme row); ECCC snow rows are snow-rate classes in cm/h (official 14-class scale, not dBZ); JMA nowcast colors are Z-R estimated dBZ equivalents (mm/h classes 1-80; 80+ class unverified); GFS MODEL estimates (6-h mean rates, snow at 10:1 snow-to-liquid ratio) render in the same colors where no radar covers — model output, never radar. ECCC snow echoes render blue ONLY where SfcPrecipType classifies snow (or the snow product alone echoes; mixed/freezing rain render on the dBZ key). MRMS SeamlessHSR snow is classified by PrecipFlag (flag 3) and ranked from PrecipRate at 10:1 SLR. Snow rows are ECCC snow-rate classes in cm/h (official 14-class scale); GFS snow ranks water-equivalent rate at 10:1 SLR on the same bands.

Sources: NOAA/NSSL MRMS SeamlessHSR hybrid-scan reflectivity composite + PrecipFlag/PrecipRate (CONUS, Alaska, Hawaii, Caribbean; dBZ, public domain) + ECCC North American Radar Composite 1km rain (RADAR_1KM_RRAI, mm/h) / snow (RADAR_1KM_RSNO, cm/h) / precipitation type (Radar_1km_SfcPrecipType) + EUMETNET OPERA EU DBZH composite (CC BY 4.0) in remaining radar gaps + JMA Japan nowcast (attribution) in Japan gaps + NOAA GFS model estimates, same colors (public domain) in verified radar gaps only
Precedence: ECCC rain (rates -> dBZ via NWS Z=300R^1.4 onto the original N0Q key) wins everywhere its RADAR_COVERAGE_*.INV dynamic coverage is valid, including most of CONUS; ECCC snow renders in the blue snow ramp at the same severity rank ONLY where Radar_1km_SfcPrecipType classifies snow (mixed/freezing rain render on the dBZ key); NOAA/NSSL MRMS SeamlessHSR (CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB: measured dBZ onto the original N0Q key bins; PrecipFlag 3 = snow -> blue snow ramp ranked from PrecipRate at 10:1 SLR) fills ECCC gaps; OPERA EU DBZH fills remaining non-NA radar gaps on the N0Q key (undifferentiated); JMA nowcast intensity (mm/h classes) fills Japan gaps via Z-R equivalents (undifferentiated); GFS model estimates (CSNOW-gated snow blues, CRAIN key colors, same colors as radar) only in verified radar gaps; transparent elsewhere.
Coverage: Global Coverage
Radar note: radar echoes (MRMS CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB/ECCC/OPERA/JMA); GFS model estimates (not radar) in verified radar gaps, same colors
